# Gradle wrapper provenance

The checked-in Gradle wrapper JAR and generated gradlew / gradlew.bat scripts are
upstream Gradle components under Apache-2.0, rather than addon-authored scripts.
Their copyright headers are retained. LICENSE is copied from the wrapper JAR's
META-INF/LICENSE; NOTICE is retained from the verified Gradle 8.8 distribution.

Wrapper SHA-256: `cb0da6751c2b753a16ac168bb354870ebb1e162e9083f116729cec9c781156b8`.
The distribution checksum is declared in gradle-wrapper.properties.
These build components are included in the source checkout, not the mod JAR.
